ending_at.title: Ending At
ending_at.description: End of the period this row covers (exclusive), as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp: the end of the row's time bucket when a time-bucket width is set; otherwise the requested `ending_at` (or, when omitted, the earlier of now and `starting_at` plus 31 days) rounded down to the hour, because without a time bucket the report covers whole hours.

group.description: The dimension values this row's cost is broken out by.

starting_at.title: Starting At
starting_at.description: Start of the period this row covers (inclusive), as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp: the start of the row's time bucket when a time-bucket width is set, otherwise the requested `starting_at` rounded down to the hour.
